chunks: He who has assigned (the propagation) of the Qur'an to you will bring you back to the destination. Say: "My Lord knows who has come to guidance, and who is clearly in error."
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the certainty of return to God and divine knowledge of guidance?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine guarantee of the Ma'ad (return), linking the weight of the Qur'anic revelation directly to the certainty of resurrection. It serves as a reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) that despite opposition, the One who imposed the Qur'an as a burden will also restore him to his ultimate abode, affirming God's omniscience regarding true guidance versus clear misguidance.
